name: ledger
title_zh: 17 条工程纪律，专治 Agent 说「已验证」
tagline_zh: 你的 Agent 改完代码说「测试通过」，其实一行都没跑。这套技能把「声称」和「跑过」分开记账。
tagline_en: Your agent says "tests pass" without running a thing. These skills separate claims from actual runs — retractions.
desc_en: Stops your coding agent from claiming it verified what it never ran. 17 engineering skills for agent-authored codebases — with the evals, and the retractions, published.
why_zh: 每条技能都带可复现的评测和撤回记录，不是拍脑袋的提示词合集。它管的是 Agent 自写代码的工程纪律。
why_en: Every skill ships with reproducible evals and retraction logs, not vibes-based prompts. It governs discipline for agent-authored.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Agent 自己写出来的代码库，人写的遗留项目收益有限；17 条是纪律约束不是生成器，装上不会多写一行功能。
limit_en: Only targets agent-authored codebases; limited gain on human-written legacy. It's discipline, not a generator — no extra features. Evals are.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 17 engineering skills that stop your agent faking.
